rows.chain: official dr1m90_npu -> NPU app/runtime and driver source
facts: nearest release tag is SDK_2026.01
repository HEAD is three commits after the tag

rows.chain: current board boot partition -> active boot files
facts: /dev/mmcblk1p1 is mounted as the boot partition and /dev/mmcblk1p2 is root
BOOT.bin, boot.scr, system.dtb and uImage.lz4 hashes were captured
boot.scr loads uImage.lz4 and system.dtb and passes root=/dev/mmcblk1p2
BOOT.bin metadata says board=evb_dr1m90 and Release 5.9.1 Build 151508
BOOT.bin is an opaque ALGC container and no embedded bitstream name was recovered
model is Anlogic, DR1M90 FPSoc
hard_npu compatible is anlogic,hard_npu with 0x63f00000/0x100000, 0xf8800000/0x200 and 0xf8801000/0x100 resources
hard_npu interrupt is SPI 112
soft_npu node is absent
linux,cma is shared-dma-pool, default, 128 MiB
FPGA manager is anlogic,dr1m90-pcap-fpga at 0xf8801000

rows.source: board, VM SDK source and Task 023 isolated artifacts
facts: board kernel is 6.1.111-rt42 #8 AArch64
SDK NPU Kconfig exposes HARD_NPU_DRIVER, SOFT_NPU_DRIVER and CMA_MEM_DRIVER
SDK drivers/npu/Makefile includes the subdirectories when CONFIG_NPU_MODULE is enabled
three AArch64 modules have matching text vermagic but no __versions section and empty generated Module.symvers
all module undefined symbol names were found in board /proc/kallsyms, but export/CRC provenance is incomplete
no NPU driver is loaded and no NPU device node exists on the board
